myAccount.title: My Account
myAccount.subtitle: Settings that belong to you rather than to the organization.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Appearance and workflow settings, stored with your account rather than this browser.

security.title: Sign-in security
security.description: Whether a second factor is required is an organization setting. What you use to satisfy it is your choice.

descriptions.owner: Everything, including backups and integration tokens.
descriptions.editor: Creates content, publishes it, and manages screens and playback.
descriptions.contributor: Creates and edits content, but cannot publish a Layout, delete anything, or put content on a screen.

users.accessDenied: Your role doesn't include managing people.

addForm.title: Add a user
addForm.passwordHint: Passwords must contain at least 12 characters.

mfa.required: Two-step verification required, not yet enrolled

editDialog.title: Edit {{name}}
editDialog.mfaEnrolled: This account has an authenticator app or a passkey enrolled.
editDialog.mfaNotEnrolled: This account has no second factor enrolled.
editDialog.resetConfirmTitle: Clear every authenticator, passkey, and recovery code for {{name}}?
editDialog.resetConfirmBody: They will be signed out everywhere and must enroll again.
editDialog.deleteBody: This removes their login, preferences, and security credentials. This cannot be undone.

errors.requestFailed: Tilecast could not update this account.

access.roleDescription: What this person can do in Studio.
access.contentDescription: Which media this person can reach and which tags they can apply.
access.screensDescription: Which screens this person can reach.
access.selfNote: You can't change your own access. Ask another administrator.

security.loadError: Sign-in security could not be loaded.

authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.description: A six-digit code from an app such as Aegis, Google Authenticator, or 1Password.
authenticator.enrollInstruction: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
authenticator.manualKeyLabel: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand:
authenticator.removeDescription: Confirm your password to remove the authenticator from this account.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with a fingerprint, face, screen lock, or security key. A passkey signs you in on its own and counts as two-step verification.
passkeys.unavailableTitle: Passkeys are unavailable on this installation.
passkeys.browserUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.renameHint: Tilecast named this from the authenticator that created it.
passkeys.removeDescription: Confirm your password to remove this passkey from this account.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: Single-use codes that let you sign in when you cannot reach your authenticator or passkey.
recovery.dialogDescription: Confirm your password to generate new codes. Any existing recovery codes stop working.
recovery.shownOnceDescription: Save them somewhere safe now. Tilecast stores only their hashes and cannot show them again.

errors.requestFailed: Tilecast could not complete the request.

qr.failed: The QR code could not be displayed. Enter the key below by hand instead.

preferences.leaveWarning: Leave My Account with unsaved preference changes?
preferences.conflict: These preferences changed elsewhere. Reload the latest preferences before saving.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Follow this browser, or force Studio light or dark.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language Studio uses for you. Names, content, and messages from Players are not translated.

oauth.invalidDescription: The authorization request is not valid.
oauth.title: Authorize access
oauth.intro: “{{client}}” asks to act in Tilecast as you. Check the access below before you approve.
oauth.decisionError: Tilecast could not record the decision.
oauth.grantsDescription: Loopback operators that may act as this account. Revoking takes effect immediately.
oauth.grantsError: Authorization grants could not be loaded.
oauth.revokeError: Tilecast could not revoke the grant.

pat.title: Personal access tokens
pat.description: Named tokens for scripts and automation. Tokens always expire; the secret is shown once at creation and never again.
pat.error: Personal access tokens could not be loaded.
pat.createError: Tilecast could not create the token.
pat.createdWarning: Copy it now. This secret will never be shown again.
pat.revokeError: Tilecast could not revoke the token.

media_read.label: View media
media_read.description: See media in the library and its details.

media_edit.label: Edit media details
media_edit.description: Rename, describe, set availability, and retry processing.

media_organize.label: Move and collect media
media_organize.description: Move media between folders and in or out of collections.

media_tags_assign.label: Apply tags
media_tags_assign.description: Add and remove tags on media. Content access can limit which tags.

media_archive.label: Archive and restore media
media_archive.description: Take media out of rotation and bring it back.

media_delete.label: Delete media
media_delete.description: Delete media permanently, and delete folders, tags, or collections the role manages.

media_folders_manage.label: Manage folders
media_folders_manage.description: Create, rename, and move folders. Needs the whole library.

media_tags_manage.label: Manage tags
media_tags_manage.description: Create and rename tags. Needs every tag.

media_collections_manage.label: Manage collections
media_collections_manage.description: Create and rename collections. Needs the whole library.

widget_edit.label: Create and edit Widgets
widget_edit.description: Build and change Widgets and websites.

widget_delete.label: Archive and delete Widgets
widget_delete.description: Take Widgets out of rotation or delete them.

datasource_read.label: View Data Sources
datasource_read.description: See Data Sources and their data.

datasource_edit.label: Create and edit Data Sources
datasource_edit.description: Connect feeds, calendars, spreadsheets, and manual data.

datasource_manage.label: Manage Data Sources
datasource_manage.description: Delete Data Sources and create forms that collect responses.

playlist_edit.label: Edit playlists
playlist_edit.description: Create playlists and change drafts. Without publish, changes go to review.

playlist_publish.label: Publish playlists
playlist_publish.description: Put playlist changes live and restore earlier versions.

layout_edit.label: Edit Layouts
layout_edit.description: Create Layouts and change drafts. Without publish, changes go to review.

layout_publish.label: Publish Layouts
layout_publish.description: Put Layout changes live and restore earlier versions.

campaign_edit.label: Edit campaigns
campaign_edit.description: Create campaigns, change drafts, and archive them.

content_review.label: Review submissions
content_review.description: Approve, request changes, schedule, and roll back submitted content.

screen_read.label: View screens
screen_read.description: See screens, Display Groups, status, live view, and playback.

screen_manage.label: Manage screens
screen_manage.description: Change screen settings, groups, locations, commands, and Player updates.

screen_pair.label: Pair and revoke screens
screen_pair.description: Approve new players and revoke their credentials.

screen_assign.label: Assign content to screens
screen_assign.description: Choose what plays, start takeovers, and present with AirPlay.

schedule_read.label: View schedules
schedule_read.description: See schedules and what they will play.

schedule_edit.label: Edit schedules
schedule_edit.description: Create, change, turn on or off, and delete schedules.

activity_read.label: View activity
activity_read.description: See fleet health, proof of play, incidents, and screen timelines.

activity_audit.label: View content history
activity_audit.description: See the audit log of content changes.

activity_manage.label: Manage activity
activity_manage.description: See the full audit log, export reports, and update incidents and retention.

plugins_use.label: Use plugins
plugins_use.description: Open plugin pages and browse the Plugin Store.

plugins_manage.label: Manage plugins
plugins_manage.description: Install, update, configure, and remove plugins.

users_manage.label: Manage people
users_manage.description: Add accounts and set their role, content access, and screen access.

settings_manage.label: Change installation settings
settings_manage.description: Edit organization settings, branding, and notifications.

system_manage.label: Run system maintenance
system_manage.description: See system status and run maintenance.

player_releases.label: Player releases
player_releases.description: Check, cache, and remove Player releases.

page.intro: A role is what someone can do. Built-in roles are fixed; add your own to give people exactly the access their work needs.
page.deleteBody: Nobody holds this role. Deleting it cannot be undone.
page.deleteInUse_one: {{count}} person still holds this role. Move them to another role first.
page.deleteInUse_other: {{count}} people still hold this role. Move them to another role first.

editor.description: Choose what people with this role can do. Content and screen access, set per person on the Users page, narrow where they can do it.
editor.builtinDescription: Built-in roles cannot be changed. Duplicate one to start a custom role from it.
editor.capabilitiesHint: Turning on an action also turns on what it needs, such as viewing before uploading.
editor.capabilitiesViewHint: Everything this role allows, by area.
editor.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can grant this.
editor.notYours: Your own role does not include this.

contentAccess.ownerNote: Owners always reach the whole library and can apply every tag.
contentAccess.loadError: Content access could not be loaded.
contentAccess.roleHasNoMedia: This person's role doesn't include Media or Widgets, so content access has no effect until their role does.
contentAccess.notConfigured: This account has no content access yet, so it can't see any media. Choose access and save.

library.description: A folder includes everything inside it.
library.allHint: Every folder, plus media that isn't in a folder.
library.restrictedHint_one: {{count}} folder selected. Media outside it, including unfiled media, stays hidden.
library.restrictedHint_other: {{count}} folders selected. Media outside them, including unfiled media, stays hidden.
library.noFolders: There are no folders yet. Create folders in Media first.
library.subtreeNote: Uploads from this person land in one of these folders.
library.emptyNote: With no folders selected, this person can't see or upload any media.

tags.description: Tags label media, for example to feed a tag-based playlist. They never make media visible.
